plugin_desc: UTStarcom BBS4000/EPON4000 access-device SNMP collection under enterprise PEN 1949. Beyond the shared Access SNMP floor for MIB-II uptime and IF-MIB 64-bit HC interface traffic, it walks the private board performance table for per-board CPU utilization, memory utilization and board temperature. CPU and memory are Integer32 values 0-1000 and are converted to percent on the query side by dividing by 10. Board type is collected as a dimension. PON, ONU, optical transceiver, fan and power-supply tables are not promoted to shared device-health metrics. Supported brands/models - UTStarcom BBS4000 and EPON4000 access devices that expose the private board performance table and standard IF-MIB.
name: Access

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage

dimensions.name: boardPhyId
dimensions.description: Board physical ID (1-12 service, 13 CSM A, 14 CSM B)

metrics.description: Per-board CPU utilization from utsSystemPerfCpuUtil. The SNMP Integer32 is 0-1000; the query divides by 10 so the metric is reported as percent, not the raw tenths value.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage

dimensions.name: boardPhyId
dimensions.description: Board physical ID (1-12 service, 13 CSM A, 14 CSM B)

metrics.description: Per-board memory utilization from utsSystemPerfMemUtil. The SNMP Integer32 is 0-1000; the query divides by 10 so the metric is reported as percent, not the raw tenths value.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius

dimensions.name: boardPhyId
dimensions.description: Board physical ID (1-12 service, 13 CSM A, 14 CSM B)

metrics.description: Per-board temperature from utsSystemPerfTemperature, reported directly in degrees Celsius.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
